name: EXECUTOR_DRAIN_STALL_LQ1685_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: EXECUTOR_DRAIN_STALL_LQ1685 — 2026-11-09 14:22 ET a promote drained the n8n run executor while
disk-hygiene was in flight: started=0 for 2894 s (next start 15:10:18), and the 15:36 promote repeated it
(1730 s). A second request rewrote requested_at and pushed the backstop from 15:03:43 to 15:37:16.
The gate pins: while draining the old executor keeps claiming and only closes intake for a final drain
once every in-flight run is predicted to end within 150 s (hard cap 180 s, then intake re-opens); a forced
exit is postponed while a run is inside its own timeout; a rewritten request keeps the earliest requested_at
and the largest deadline_s; the deadline covers the longest in-flight timeout plus lost_grace; and the
deploy helper refuses (exit 3) to start a drain in market hours while a run older than 300 s is in flight.
Hermetic: temporary ledgers and release dirs, a fake clock, fake runners; no live ledger, no systemd.
